item.text:
**Bottom line**
- 5B.10 is **mixed, leaning slightly negative**. AMLO left Mexico with credible macro institutions and some improved social indicators, but also with weaker fiscal space, unresolved security costs, and major institutional damage that likely worsened the medium-term trajectory once external constraints are accounted for.

**Accepted claims**
- [Mexico: 2024 Article IV Consultation and Review Under the Flexible Credit Line Arrangement](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/11/01/mexico-2024-article-iv-consultation-and-review-under-the-flexible-credit-line-arrangement-556997) | IMF | 2024-11-01  
  The IMF said Mexico still qualified for the FCL because its macro frameworks, policy implementation record, and fundamentals were very strong, and it said inflation pressures were receding. But it also warned that 2024 fiscal expansion was procyclical, employment growth was slowing, and sustainable growth needed broader reforms and fiscal consolidation.  
  IDs: `5B.10`, `5B.9`, `5B.6`

- [Mexico: Staff Concluding Statement of the 2024 AIV Mission](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/10/15/mcs-mexico-staff-concluding-statement-of-the-2024-aiv-mission) | IMF | 2024-10-15  
  The IMF praised Mexico’s frameworks but said growth was slowing because of binding capacity constraints, procyclical fiscal expansion, and investment/consumption bottlenecks. This weakens the case that AMLO left a clearly stronger trajectory than he inherited.  
  IDs: `5B.10`, `5B.9`, `5B.6`

- [Banxico cut interest rate to 10.75% in divided vote, but sees higher inflation](https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/mexicos-central-bank-cuts-benchmark-interest-rate-to-1075-in-divided-vote-3562752) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-08  
  Banxico’s rate cut showed the macro framework still functioned, but the bank was still warning inflation would remain higher than previously expected. That is only partial evidence of an improved trajectory.  
  IDs: `5B.10`, `5B.9`, `5B.3`

- [Mexico's GDP, inflation figures support bets of September rate cut](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/mexicos-gdp-inflation-figures-support-bets-of-september-rate-cut-3583901) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-22  
  Reuters reported inflation slowed more than expected while growth remained weak, opening the door to another rate cut. This suggests stabilization, but not a clearly stronger long-run trajectory.  
  IDs: `5B.10`, `5B.9`, `5B.3`

- [Mexico headline inflation hits highest level in more than a year](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/mexicos-headline-inflation-hits-highest-level-in-more-than-a-year-3561838) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-08  
  Headline inflation rose to 5.57% in July, the highest in more than a year. That is strong negative evidence against a cleanly improved trajectory.  
  IDs: `5B.10`, `5B.9`, `5B.3`

- [Economía de México es sólida y hay responsabilidad en manejo de finanzas: presidente](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/economia-de-mexico-es-solida-y-hay-responsabilidad-en-manejo-de-finanzas-presidente/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-06-04  
  AMLO argued the economy was solid and that the policy would not change, while dismissing concern as alarmism. This supports continuity, but it is mostly deflection rather than an independent case that the trajectory was clearly stronger.  
  IDs: `5B.10`, `5B.9`, `5B.7`

- [200 puntos del sexto informe de gobierno](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/200-puntos-del-sexto-informe-de-gobierno/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-09-01  
  The Sixth Report claimed gains in poverty, inflation, debt, investment, and public programs. This is relevant positive self-reporting, but it is not independent validation of a stronger trajectory.  
  IDs: `5B.10`, `5B.9`, `5B.7`

- [Gobierno federal presenta caso de evasión fiscal de Totalplay; debe más de mil 500 millones de pesos al SAT](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-presenta-caso-de-evasion-fiscal-de-totalplay-debe-mas-de-mil-500-millones-de-pesos-al-sat/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-03-15  
  The administration publicly pursued a tax-evasion case against a politically connected company. That is positive for rule enforcement and against connected-business privilege, but it does not by itself show a stronger aggregate economic trajectory.  
  IDs: `5B.10`, `5B.5`, `5B.7`

- [Mexico and the U.S. agreed to clamp down on illegal immigration, leaders say](https://theprint.in/world/us-mexico-to-clamp-down-on-illegal-immigration-leaders-say/2062785/) | Reuters | 2024-04-30  
  Mexico handled border pressure through coordination and human-rights language rather than blanket coercion. That is limited positive evidence of competent crisis handling under external pressure.  
  IDs: `5B.10`, `5B.9`, `5B.7`

- [Rampant extortion reveals corrosive hole in Mexico's security strategy](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/rampant-extortion-reveals-corrosive-hole-in-mexico-security-strategy-3283251) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-01-25  
  Reuters said extortion remained far above the level when AMLO took office, undercutting any claim that the broader inherited security/economic environment was transformed for the better. This is negative evidence on the trajectory question.  
  IDs: `5B.10`, `5B.9`, `5B.1`

- [Mexico constitutional reforms more likely with supermajority in sight](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-04  
  Reuters reported investor concern that AMLO might use the post-election mandate to sweep aside checks on presidential power. This is indirect but important negative evidence that the trajectory for investment and institutional predictability may have worsened.  
  IDs: `5B.10`, `5B.7`, `5B.5`

- [Mexico's sweeping judicial overhaul formally takes effect](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-15  
  Reuters reported the judicial overhaul weakened judicial independence and investor confidence. That is negative evidence because a stronger trajectory depends on enforceable rules and predictable institutions.  
  IDs: `5B.10`, `5B.7`, `5B.5`

**Search gap**
- I found **good evidence on macro stability, inflation management, and external-credit credibility**, but **no clean counterfactual showing the economy was unambiguously stronger at the end than at the start** once security costs, judicial damage, and fiscal strain are included.
- The strongest positive evidence is concentrated in **institutional macro credibility** rather than in **broad growth, productivity, or private-investment acceleration**.
- The strongest negative evidence is about **medium-term drag**: higher inflation in 2024, procyclical fiscal policy, extortion/security burdens, and weaker judicial predictability.
